title: The first week
blurb: Daily only. The first seven days you both answer, in this order.

questions.text: What will I say is the best meal we have had together?

options: Be out of the house by nine

questions.text: What do I do when I think nobody is watching?
Where would I go tomorrow if we could both take the day off?
options: A city we have never seen

questions.text: What is something small I do that you would miss by Wednesday?
What has been on my mind this week that I have not brought up?
What from this week do you want to remember?
